title: Staff Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? The Data Infrastructure team at Cohere is responsible for the storage and data movement layer underlying every model training run. We're building the unified storage layer that feeds our training workloads at petabyte scale. In this role, you would have the opportunity to architect and lead the design of this system from the ground up, serving petabytes of training data and model checkpoints fast enough to keep thousands of GPUs busy across several training clusters. You'd be a key contributor, leading the effort to solve a problem few teams have tackled at this scale. In this role, you will: Design, architect, and operate the distributed storage system that feeds model training and evaluation, driving the technical vision from concept through production. Lead and own the deployment of this system across multiple Kubernetes clusters at petabyte scale, setting standards and best practices for the organization. Collabo…

title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Travel
description: About the Team OpenAI’s Consumer Verticals team builds experiences that make ChatGPT more useful in the areas that matter to people every day. Within Travel, we’re exploring how AI can help people discover destinations, compare options, and plan trips around their preferences and needs. Travel planning brings together inspiration, personal preferences, and practical constraints—from budgets and schedules to changing prices and availability. We aim to make that complexity easier to navigate, combining advanced AI capabilities, relevant travel information, and thoughtful product design to help people move from an idea to a trip with greater confidence. We work closely with product, design, research, safety, privacy, and other ChatGPT teams to turn emerging AI capabilities into useful consumer experiences, with a high bar for quality, reliability, and user trust. About the Role We’re looking for a product-minded full stack software engineer to help shape the next generation of travel experiences in ChatGPT. You will own features end-to-end, from early exploration and prototypes through launch and iteration. Your work will span intuitive interfaces, backend services, and integrations that connect conversational experiences with travel information and services. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy shaping new product areas, making complex information intuitive, and moving quickly from idea to production. Prior experience in AI or travel is not required. In this role you will Build consumer travel experiences across ChatGPT’s web and mobile surfaces, with ownership spanning frontend interfaces, backend services, and external integrations.
